title: Single-cell mass cytometry reveals cell type- and cluster-specific heterogeneity in silver nanoparticle responses in a 3D alveolar tetra-culture model

Silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) are widely used in medicine, environmental science, and industry. However, their heterogeneous interactions with complex biological systems, especially at the single-cell level, are not fully understood yet....
